```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// The two hazards this section maps. `code` is the hazard id in the parquet,
// `breaks` are the Atlas class thresholds for that indicator, collapsed from the
// four published categories to the three the bivariate palette has: "no
// significant stress", "moderate", then severe and extreme together.
//
// Drought is number of dry days (NDD, P < 1 mm) rather than soil water stress
// days (NDWS): as a monthly count NDWS sits at its ceiling almost everywhere in
// Africa — 89% of admin units above 28 of ~30 days — so every unit classified as
// extreme and the drought axis carried no information. NDD uses the same
// published thresholds and spans all four classes.
S2_HAZARDS = new Object({
  drought: {
    code: "NDD-mean",
    column: "dryDays",
    breaks: [15, 20],
    label: nbText.s2HazardDrought,
    mapTitle: nbText.s2MapTitleDrought,
  },
  waterlogging: {
    code: "NDWL0-mean",
    column: "waterloggingDays",
    breaks: [2, 5],
    label: nbText.s2HazardWaterlogging,
    mapTitle: nbText.s2MapTitleWaterlogging,
  },
})

// Query hazard data with SQL-side admin filtering.
hazardData = {
  // Bindings are positional, so the admin clause is built and placed first.
  const bind = createSqlBindings();
  const adminWhere = sqlAdminWhere(
    { admin0: selectedAdmin0, admin1: selectedAdmin1 },
    bind,
  );

  return await db.query(
    `
    SELECT
      iso3,
      admin0_name,
      admin1_name,
      admin2_name,
      hazard,
      value
    FROM hazard_data
    WHERE ${adminWhere}
      AND hazard IN (${bind.list(Object.values(S2_HAZARDS).map((h) => h.code))})
      AND stat = ${bind.value("mean")}
  `,
    bind.params,
  );
}

// One row per admin unit with a column per hazard. The stat filter above matters:
// each unit has both a mean and an sd row per hazard, so without it the value
// picked here depended on row order and landed on the sd for ~24% of units.
hazardByAdmin = {
  const grouped = d3.group(
    hazardData,
    (d) => `${d.iso3}_${d.admin0_name}_${d.admin1_name}_${d.admin2_name}`,
  );

  return Array.from(grouped.values()).map((group) => {
    const base = group[0];
    const values = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.values(S2_HAZARDS).map((hazard) => {
        const row = group.find((d) => d.hazard === hazard.code);
        return [hazard.column, row ? parseFloat(row.value) : null];
      }),
    );

    return {
      iso3: base.iso3,
      admin0_name: base.admin0_name,
      admin1_name: base.admin1_name,
      admin2_name: base.admin2_name,
      ...values,
    };
  });
}

combinedData = {
  const hazardColumns = Object.values(S2_HAZARDS).map((h) => h.column);

  return filteredData
    .map((cis) => {
      // Match by exact admin name at every level.
      const hazard = hazardByAdmin.find(
        (h) =>
          h.iso3 === cis.iso3 &&
          h.admin0_name === cis.admin0_name &&
          h.admin1_name === cis.admin1_name &&
          h.admin2_name === cis.admin2_name,
      );

      return {
        ...cis,
        ...Object.fromEntries(
          hazardColumns.map((col) => [col, hazard?.[col] ?? null]),
        ),
      };
    })
    .filter((d) => hazardColumns.some((col) => d[col] !== null));
}

// ============================================================================
// BIVARIATE CLASSIFICATION FUNCTION
// ============================================================================
// Places a region on a 3×3 grid of CIS readiness (from thresholds.json) against
// hazard severity (the class breaks on S2_HAZARDS). The resulting bivariateClass,
// e.g. "High × High", drives the map colouring; a missing hazard value yields
// "No data", which the colour scale already has an entry for.
// ============================================================================

function bivariateClassify(
  readiness,
  hazardValue,
  hazardKey,
  readinessLevel = currentAdminLevel,
) {
  const readinessClass = classifyThreshold(
    "cis_readiness_index",
    readiness,
    readinessLevel,
  );

  // Comparisons against NaN are all false, so missing values have to be caught
  // before the ladder — otherwise they fall through to the most severe class.
  const numeric = Number(hazardValue);
  const [moderate, severe] = S2_HAZARDS[hazardKey].breaks;
  const hazardClass =
    hazardValue == null || Number.isNaN(numeric)
      ? "No data"
      : numeric < moderate
        ? "Low"
        : numeric < severe
          ? "Moderate"
          : "High";

  return {
    readinessClass,
    hazardClass,
    bivariateClass:
      hazardClass === "No data"
        ? "No data"
        : `${readinessClass} × ${hazardClass}`,
  };
}

bivariateColors = {
  return {
    "Low × Low": "#e8e8e8",       // Light gray - lowest priority
    "Low × Moderate": "#b8d6be",  
    "Low × High": "#6c9a8b",       // Teal-green - high need, low capacity (GAP)
    "Moderate × Low": "#c8b2d6",
    "Moderate × Moderate": "#9c9eba",
    "Moderate × High": "#627a8e",
    "High × Low": "#b8a0c2",      
    "High × Moderate": "#8b7fa8",
    "High × High": "#5a5f8f",      // Dark purple - OPTIMAL (priority for CIS)
    // Distinct from "Low × Low": a unit with no hazard value must not read as a
    // low-hazard one. Matches the missing-data grey section 3 uses.
    "No data": "#cccccc"
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Process and classify data
s2ProcessedData = {
  const hazardColumn = S2_HAZARDS[s2HazardType].column;

  return combinedData
    .filter(d => d.cis_readiness_index != null && d[hazardColumn] !== null)
    .map(d => {
    const classified = bivariateClassify(
      d.cis_readiness_index,
      d[hazardColumn],
      s2HazardType,
      d,
    );
    
    return {
      ...d,
      hazardValue: d[hazardColumn],
      ...classified
    };
  });
}

// Prepare map data at the appropriate admin level
s2MapData = {
  const level = currentAdminLevel; //TODO: This filtering has to go / be re-used across notebook
  
  if (level === 0) {
    // Group by admin0
    const grouped = d3.group(s2ProcessedData, d => d.gaul0_code);
    return Array.from(grouped.values()).map(group => {
      const first = group[0];
      const avgReadiness = d3.mean(group, d => d.cis_readiness_index);
      const avgHazard = d3.mean(group, d => d.hazardValue);
      const classified = bivariateClassify(avgReadiness, avgHazard, s2HazardType, 0);
      
      return {
        admin0_name: first.admin0_name,
        iso3: first.iso3,
        gaul0_code: first.gaul0_code,
        cis_readiness_index: avgReadiness,
        hazardValue: avgHazard,
        ...classified
      };
    });
  } else if (level === 1) {
    // Group by admin1
    const grouped = d3.group(s2ProcessedData, d => d.gaul1_code);
    return Array.from(grouped.values()).map(group => {
      const first = group[0];
      const avgReadiness = d3.mean(group, d => d.cis_readiness_index);
      const avgHazard = d3.mean(group, d => d.hazardValue);
      const classified = bivariateClassify(avgReadiness, avgHazard, s2HazardType, 1);
      
      return {
        admin0_name: first.admin0_name,
        admin1_name: first.admin1_name,
        iso3: first.iso3,
        gaul0_code: first.gaul0_code,
        gaul1_code: first.gaul1_code,
        cis_readiness_index: avgReadiness,
        hazardValue: avgHazard,
        ...classified
      };
    });
  } else {
    // admin2 - use as is
    return s2ProcessedData;
  }
}

// Load appropriate boundaries based on Section 1's admin level

// Join boundaries with data
s2GeoData = {
  const gaulCodeField = currentAdminLevel === 0 ? 'gaul0_code' :
                        currentAdminLevel === 1 ? 'gaul1_code' :
                        'gaul2_code';
  
  // Narrow to the selection by name only — regions without data still draw, faded.
  const filteredBoundaries =
    currentAdminLevel === 0
      ? currentBoundaries
      : {
          ...currentBoundaries,
          features: currentBoundaries.features.filter((f) =>
            inCurrentSelection(f.properties),
          ),
        };

  const features = filteredBoundaries.features.map(feature => {
    const gaulCode = feature.properties[gaulCodeField];
    let match = s2MapData.find(d => d[gaulCodeField] === gaulCode);
    
    // Fallback: try matching by admin names if GAUL code fails
    if (!match && currentAdminLevel === 2) {
      match = s2MapData.find(d => 
        d.admin0_name === feature.properties.admin0_name &&
        d.admin1_name === feature.properties.admin1_name &&
        d.admin2_name === feature.properties.admin2_name
      );
    } else if (!match && currentAdminLevel === 1) {
      match = s2MapData.find(d => 
        d.admin0_name === feature.properties.admin0_name &&
        d.admin1_name === feature.properties.admin1_name
      );
    }
    
    // Check if this admin2 region is highlighted
    const isHighlighted = currentAdminLevel === 2 && 
                          selectedAdmin2.length > 0 && 
                          selectedAdmin2.includes(feature.properties.admin2_name);
    
    return {
      type: "Feature",
      geometry: feature.geometry,
      properties: {
        ...feature.properties,
        ...(match || {}),
        isHighlighted: isHighlighted,
        hasData: !!match
      }
    };
  }); // Show all features, fade those without data
  
  return { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Render map or table based on toggle
s2BivariateMap = {
  if (s2ViewToggle !== "map") return null;
  const hazardName = s2HazardType === "drought" ? "Drought (Dry Spell Days)" : "Waterlogging (Days)";
  
  return makeChoropleth({
    features: s2GeoData,
    width: 775,
    height: 610,
    projection: "mercator",
    fill: d => d.properties.hasData ? d.properties.bivariateClass : "No data",
    color: {
      type: "categorical",
      legend: false,
      // Insertion order of the palette is the class order the legend expects.
      domain: Object.keys(bivariateColors),
      range: Object.values(bivariateColors),
      label: "Bivariate Class"
    },
    channels: {
      region: {
        label: "Region",
        value: (d) => currentAdminLevel === 0
          ? d.properties.admin0_name
          : currentAdminLevel === 1
          ? `${d.properties.admin1_name}, ${d.properties.admin0_name}`
          : `${d.properties.admin2_name}, ${d.properties.admin1_name}`
      },
      readiness: {
        label: "Readiness (0-1)",
        value: (d) => fmt(d.properties.cis_readiness_index, 2)
      },
      hazard: {
        label: hazardName,
        value: (d) => fmt(d.properties.hazardValue, 1)
      },
      bivariateClass: {
        label: "Bivariate class",
        value: (d) => d.properties.bivariateClass || "N/A"
      }
    },
    tooltip: {
      region: true,
      readiness: true,
      hazard: true,
      bivariateClass: true
    },
    baseMarkOptions: {
      fillOpacity: d => d.properties.hasData ? 1 : 0.3
    },
    adminHighlight
  });
}

// Render map or table based on toggle
{
  if (s2ViewToggle === "map") {
    const hazardLegendLabel = s2HazardType === "drought" ? "Drought Severity" : "Waterlogging Severity";
    return html`
      <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <div style="flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; justify-content: center;">
          ${makeBivariateLegend({
            colors: bivariateColors,
            xLabel: "CIS Readiness",
            yLabel: hazardLegendLabel,
            width: 220,
            height: 210,
            fontSize: 14
          })}
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 640px; min-width: 0;">
          ${s2BivariateMap}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  } else {
    // Table view
    const hazardName = s2HazardType === "drought" ? "Drought (Days)" : "Waterlogging (Days)";
    
    const tableData = s2MapData.map(d => {
      const adminName = adminDisplayName(d);
      
      let priorityLevel;
      if (d.bivariateClass === "High × High") priorityLevel = "Critical";
      else if (d.bivariateClass.includes("High") && d.bivariateClass.includes("Moderate")) priorityLevel = "Moderate";
      else if (d.bivariateClass.includes("High")) priorityLevel = "Moderate";
      else priorityLevel = "Low";
      
      return {
        adminName: adminName,
        readinessRaw: d.cis_readiness_index,
        readinessClass: d.readinessClass,
        hazardRaw: d.hazardValue,
        hazardClass: d.hazardClass,
        bivariateClass: d.bivariateClass,
        priorityLevel: priorityLevel
      };
    });
    
    return filterableDataTable(tableData, {
      columns: [
        "adminName",
        "readinessRaw",
        "readinessClass",
        "hazardRaw",
        "hazardClass",
        "priorityLevel"
      ],
      header: {
        adminName: "Admin Name",
        readinessRaw: "CIS Readiness",
        readinessClass: "Readiness Class",
        hazardRaw: hazardName,
        hazardClass: "Hazard Class",
        priorityLevel: "Priority Level"
      },
      format: {
        readinessRaw: d => d.toFixed(2),
        hazardRaw: d => d.toFixed(1)
      },
      sort: "priorityLevel",
      reverse: true,
    });
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

s2Insights = {
  const hazardName = s2HazardType === "drought" ? "Drought" : "Waterlogging";
  const selectedRegion = breadcrumb; // Use the breadcrumb from Section 1
  
  // If admin2 regions are highlighted, only use those for insights
  const insightData = selectedAdmin2.length > 0 
    ? s2MapData.filter(d => selectedAdmin2.includes(d.admin2_name))
    : s2MapData;
  
  // Insight 1: Opportunity (High × High zones)
  const highHazardHighReadiness = insightData.filter(d => d.bivariateClass === "High × High");
  const percentHighHigh = insightData.length > 0 
    ? (highHazardHighReadiness.length / insightData.length * 100).toFixed(1)
    : 0;
  
  const insight1 = `In ${selectedRegion}, **${percentHighHigh}%** of areas fall in High-Readiness & High-${hazardName} zones, indicating strong potential for CIS as an adaptation measure.`;
  
  // Insight 2: Gap (High hazard with Low readiness)
  const highHazardAreas = insightData.filter(d => d.hazardClass === "High");
  const highHazardLowReadiness = highHazardAreas.filter(d => d.readinessClass === "Low");
  const percentGap = highHazardAreas.length > 0 
    ? (highHazardLowReadiness.length / highHazardAreas.length * 100).toFixed(1)
    : 0;
  
  const insight2 = `**${percentGap}%** of High-${hazardName} areas have Low CIS Readiness—priority gaps for station and forecast investment.`;
  
  return html`
    <div style="background: #f8f9fa; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 20px;">
      <h4 style="margin-top: 0;">Key Insights</h4>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;"><strong>Opportunity:</strong> ${md([insight1])}</p>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;"><strong>Investment Gap:</strong> ${md([insight2])}</p>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
